title: Software Engineer - iOS Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Software Engineer - iOS.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Entry-level / New Grad: Swift syntax, Optionals, UIViewController / SwiftUI lifecycle, AutoLayout, and URLSession basics.
2. Mid-level: SwiftUI / UIKit architecture, concurrency (async/await, Actors, GCD), CoreData / SwiftData persistence, custom animations, and unit testing.
3. Senior: Performance profiling (Instruments: Time Profiler, Allocations, Leaks), app launch optimization, dynamic frameworks, modular SPM architecture, and security (Keychain, Secure Enclave).
4. Staff-plus: Multi-app iOS platform architecture, build system acceleration, and cross-team iOS engineering excellence.

sections.heading: Question Strategy & Guidance
lines: - PREFER BRIEF PILLARS: Target the candidate's iOS portfolio and architectural choices.
- Probe Swift concurrency, memory safety (retain cycles, weak/unowned), and Apple HIG alignment.
